systems.country_label: SIPT, managed by the Centre de recueil et d'enregistrement des donnees policieres (CREDOP)
systems.owner: CREDOP, housed at the ministry in charge of public security, with legal and judicial control by the ministry in charge of justice; created by decree no. 2278 of 18 August 2023
systems.tiers: A national centre that collects, records, centralises, safeguards and shares data from checks and searches for persons and property in administrative and judicial police work; staffed from the Police nationale, Gendarmerie nationale, Garde nationale et nomade and the Coordination de la Police judiciaire; no station-level entry stated

note: The decree creates a central centre to manage SIPT; the document does not say that stations or brigades enter their reports or cases in it, so the typology gives it no class and it yields no fact.
